item.title: USMNT Coach Pochettino to Remain Through 2030 World Cup
item.description: Pochettino took charge in 2024 to stabilize the team ahead of this year's World Cup, leading them to a record three wins and sparking enthusiasm.

item.title: Washington Wildfires Destroy Homes, Force Mass Evacuations
item.description: Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown reports that nearly half the city's neighborhoods are evacuated or at risk as fires remain uncontained.

item.title: Photos: Wildfires in Spokane trigger mass evacuations
item.description: Wildfires in Spokane have destroyed hundreds of homes and forced 60,000 people to evacuate.
